outfit.description: Proposta independente PixelLab selecionada do frame 2 do lote original. Full-body adult orc warband veteran for a medieval fantasy tactical RPG. Inspired by the powerful classic orc archetype of World of Warcraft and the grounded medieval atmosphere of Tolkien, with an original design. Imposing robust anatomy, expressive tusked face, braided hair, layered forged armor and weathered leather with purposeful clan craftsmanship. Refined readable pixel art, strong silhouette, three-quarter front view, both hands empty. No weapons held, carried or sheathed, no shield, no scenery, no text. One isolated character on transparent background.
